how: kubectl -n signoz exec chi-signoz-clickhouse-cluster-0-0-0 -c clickhouse -- clickhouse-client --query "..."

queries.title: Every span of one trace, with parent links
queries.why: The timeout run. Shows the frontend stopping near 1 s while the backend carries on to 3 s.
queries.sql: SELECT toString(timestamp) AS ts, resource_string_service$$name AS service, name, kind_string AS kind, status_code_string AS status, response_status_code AS http, round(duration_nano/1e6,1) AS ms, span_id, parent_span_id FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE trace_id='fd707025097ba2c2c93c07c60eda4ea7' ORDER BY timestamp

queries.title: Slowest SQL statements
queries.why: `db.statement` is a map entry in `attributes_string`. Covers the load run.
queries.sql: SELECT attributes_string['db.statement'] AS statement, count() AS calls, round(avg(duration_nano)/1e6,1) AS avg_ms, round(max(duration_nano)/1e6,1) AS max_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE resource_string_service$$name='lab1-backend' AND attributes_string['db.system']='postgresql' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-07 11:10:17' AND '2026-11-07 11:21:03' GROUP BY statement ORDER BY max_ms DESC LIMIT 6

rows: INSERT INTO orders (item, qty, total) VALUES (%s, %s, %s) RETURNING id
SELECT id, item, qty, total, created_at FROM orders ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Exception types recorded on spans
queries.why: Reads the events array. The same types appear on the Exceptions page.
queries.sql: SELECT resource_string_service$$name AS service, JSONExtractString(e,'attributeMap','exception.type') AS exception_type, count() AS n FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 ARRAY JOIN events AS e WHERE JSONExtractString(e,'name')='exception' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-07 11:10:17' AND '2026-11-07 11:21:03' GROUP BY service, exception_type ORDER BY n DESC

queries.title: Logs for one trace
queries.why: The db_error run. Three logs from two services under one trace ID.
queries.sql: SELECT toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS ts, resources_string['service.name'] AS service, severity_text AS severity, substring(body,1,90) AS body FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE trace_id='e0156d74a8f61d779d050f6fab39994f' ORDER BY timestamp

queries.title: OTLP copies versus stdout copies
queries.why: Gap 4 in numbers, over the load run.
queries.sql: SELECT if(resources_string['service.name']='', 'stdout copy (k8s-infra)', 'OTLP copy') AS copy, count() AS n, countIf(trace_id!='') AS with_trace_id, countIf(severity_text!='') AS with_severity FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-07 11:10:17',9)) AND toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-07 11:21:03',9)) AND (resources_string['service.name'] IN ('lab1-frontend','lab1-backend','lab1-loadgen') OR (resources_string['service.name']='' AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name']='lab1')) GROUP BY copy ORDER BY copy

queries.title: What the stdout log lines actually are
queries.why: Sorts the stdout copies from the load run by what each line is. Classified by pattern, so approximate.
queries.sql: SELECT multiIf(resources_string['k8s.container.name']='postgres','Postgres', match(body,'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} '),'App log line, also sent over OTLP', body LIKE 'INFO:%/healthz%','Health probe access line', body LIKE 'INFO:%','uvicorn access line', body LIKE '%File "%' OR body LIKE ' %' OR body LIKE '%Traceback (most recent%','Stack trace line, one record per line','Other') AS kind, count() AS n FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-07 11:10:17',9)) AND toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-07 11:21:03',9)) AND resources_string['service.name']='' AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name']='lab1' GROUP BY kind ORDER BY n DESC

App log line, also sent over OTLP

queries.title: Spans with Kubernetes context
queries.why: Gap 3 in numbers, over the load run.
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS spans, countIf(resources_string['k8s.pod.name']!='') AS with_pod_name FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE resource_string_service$$name IN ('lab1-frontend','lab1-backend','frontend','backend') AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-07 11:10:17' AND '2026-11-07 11:21:03'

queries.title: Share of ASGI send and receive spans
queries.why: Gap 6 in numbers, over the load run.
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS spans, countIf(name LIKE '% http send' OR name LIKE '% http receive') AS asgi_noise, round(100*asgi_noise/spans,1) AS pct FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE resource_string_service$$name IN ('lab1-frontend','lab1-backend') AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-07 11:10:17' AND '2026-11-07 11:21:03'

queries.title: Service Map counts against real calls
queries.why: Gap 2 in numbers, over the load run. `real_calls` joins each Client span to the Server span it called. `map_calls` is what the Service Map reads.
queries.sql: SELECT r.src AS src, r.dest AS dest, r.real_calls AS real_calls, ifNull(m.map_calls,0) AS map_calls, round(100*map_calls/real_calls,1) AS pct FROM (SELECT c.s AS src, v.s AS dest, count() AS real_calls FROM (SELECT span_id, resource_string_service$$name AS s FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-07 11:10:17' AND '2026-11-07 11:21:03' AND kind_string='Client' AND resource_string_service$$name IN ('lab1-frontend','lab1-loadgen','frontend','loadgen')) AS c INNER JOIN (SELECT parent_span_id, resource_string_service$$name AS s FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-07 11:10:17' AND '2026-11-07 11:21:03' AND kind_string='Server') AS v ON c.span_id=v.parent_span_id GROUP BY src, dest) AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT src, dest, sum(total_count) AS map_calls FROM signoz_traces.distributed_dependency_graph_minutes_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-07 11:10:17' AND '2026-11-07 11:21:03' GROUP BY src, dest) AS m ON r.src=m.src AND r.dest=m.dest ORDER BY src SETTINGS join_use_nulls=1

queries.title: Backend latency before, during and after the CPU burn
queries.why: P50 of routes that did nothing wrong, split by period.
queries.sql: SELECT multiIf(timestamp < '2026-11-07 11:15:23','1 before',timestamp <= '2026-11-07 11:16:53','2 during','3 after') AS period, name, count() AS n, round(quantile(0.5)(duration_nano)/1e6,1) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_nano)/1e6,1) AS p95_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE resource_string_service$$name='lab1-backend' AND kind_string='Server' AND name IN ('GET /orders','POST /orders') AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-07 11:10:17' AND '2026-11-07 11:21:03' AND timestamp < '2026-11-07 11:18:53' GROUP BY period, name ORDER BY name, period

queries.title: Raw CPU samples for the backend pod
queries.why: One sample every 30 seconds. `sample` is a reserved word in ClickHouse SQL, so the alias is `s`.
queries.sql: SELECT toString(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli,1000))) AS t, round(s.value,3) AS cores FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s WHERE s.metric_name='k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND s.fingerprint IN (SELECT fingerprint FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.pod.name') LIKE 'lab1-backend-%') AND s.unix_milli BETWEEN 1794049817000 AND 1794050583000 ORDER BY s.unix_milli
queries.caption: Raw k8s.pod.cpu.usage samples for the lab1-backend pod, one every 30 seconds, read from ClickHouse. Shaded bands are the 90-second and 10-second burns.

queries.title: Latency by product in Lab 1, by joining logs to spans
queries.why: Lab 1 can only get this outside the search box: the item is on the log, the duration is on the span, and `span_id` joins them.
queries.sql: SELECT l.item, count() AS orders, round(quantile(0.5)(s.ms),1) AS p50_ms, round(max(s.ms),1) AS max_ms FROM (SELECT span_id, attributes_string['order.item'] AS item FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-07 11:00:50',9)) AND resources_string['service.name']='lab1-backend' AND body='order stored') AS l INNER JOIN (SELECT span_id, duration_nano/1e6 AS ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= '2026-11-07 11:00:50' AND resource_string_service$$name='lab1-backend' AND name='POST /orders') AS s ON l.span_id=s.span_id GROUP BY l.item ORDER BY max_ms DESC
